Job Requisition ID # 














 


25WD93759 
 
 Job Description

 About the Role 
 We are seeking an innovative and experienced Machine Learning Engineer  with a strong focus on  Generative AI ,  Computer Vision , and  Computer Graphics  to join our cutting-edge team at the intersection of AI and the film industry at Autodesk Flow Studio (formerly Wonder Studio), our state-of-the-art AI-powered VFX platform. In this role, you will design and implement state-of-the-art ML and GenAI models to solve complex problems in areas such as  visual effects ,  neural rendering ,  motion capture , and  3D content generation . Your work will directly impact the future of digital storytelling and content creation.
 What We’re Looking For 
 2+ years of experience  in applied Machine Learning

 Proven experience with  Deep Learning  and  Computer Vision  techniques, including but not limited to:
 CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, Autoencoders, Diffusion Models, and Transfer Learning.

 
 Hands-on experience in any of:
 3D Pose Estimation ,  Motion Reconstruction , and  Image/Video-based 3D Modeling .

 Neural Rendering ,  Generative Models  (e.g., GANs, VAEs, Diffusion), and  Photorealistic Synthesis .

 
 Strong programming skills in  Python 

 Proficiency with ML frameworks such as  PyTorch or TensorFlow .

 Solid understanding of  Computer Graphics  fundamentals, including rendering pipelines, shading, and simulation.

 Familiarity with  Numerical Optimization  techniques and differentiable programming.

 (Optional but valuable) Experience with 3D tools such as  Blender ,  Maya , or  game engines  (e.g., Unreal, Unity).

 Bachelor’s degree in  Computer Science ,  Mathematics ,  Electrical Engineering , or a related technical field.

 Excellent communication skills in  English , both written and verbal

 #LI-MM1

 Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made. 
 
 We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world. 
 
 When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!
